newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity up in July.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity up in July.

text.p: Construction activity recovered somewhat in Lebanon in July with cement deliveries reaching 395,465 tonnes, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Wednesday.
This compared with a fall in construction reported by the Bank in June compared with the previous month.
July cement deliveries were 11.5 percent up on the June total of 354,604 tonnes and were 6.5 percent higher than the July 1995 total of 371,221 tonnes, the Bank said.
It did not issue its usual monthly figures for total area of construction permits granted.
